- "Mercato editoriale" = editorial market/marketplace
- For ultra-luxury French sensorial narration, avoiding commercial terms like "marché"
- "Espace de diffusion" evokes presence, circulation, intellectual territory
- "éditoriale" maintains the publishing/editorial context
- Fits the philosophical, spatial vocabulary (espace/présence/regard)
- Appropriate length and register for editorial cockpit UI
- No anglicisms, maintains dignity and intellectual positioning

**EXPLANATION (not part of output):**
In the context of studio configuration settings, "Lingua" (Italian for "Language") becomes "Langue du récit" — literally "Language of the narrative." This transforms a utilitarian label into something poetic and editorial, positioning language selection not as a technical setting but as a choice of narrative voice. It maintains the sensorial, intellectual register while being functionally clear in a settings context. The brevity matches the source while elevating the mundane into the poetic realm expected of French ultra-luxury editorial.
